notes: Williams System 6 Test 03 (switch test) per the Blackout instruction booklet 16P-495-103, Diagnostic Procedures steps 1-7: the credit display shows 03 and the ball-in-play display shows the number of the last switch the ROM saw close, and keeps it until another closes. Each public switch 1-64 is closed alone for 400 ms with a snapshot taken while held, so the displayed number can be paired with the public address that was driven. Public 45 is written once as a control, then the lane-change matrix switch 46, which FLIP_SWNO(0,46) rewrites from PinMAME's synthetic right flipper button 82 on every update; 45 is written once more so the reading starts from 45, and the synthetic buttons 84 and 82 are then held in turn. Direct switch writes only. Run from an NVRAM initialized by one prior empty-NVRAM power-up.
